text:
deploybot: Promotion for release v2.17.0 held: artifact upload stream to s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v2.17.0.tar.gz stalled and exceeded retry window. auto-hold=true. logs: `PutObjectStreamError: stream closed (EPIPE)`

alice: ugh, in the middle of change window too. which step exactly failed? link to CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

bob: i see the job: build-artifacts -> upload-step timed out at 15m. worker logs show `socket hang up` then a bunch of retries.

carla: tests passed in the build stage earlier, so binary was created. this looks like a network/regional s3 glitch or a transient agent OOM.

ci-bot: fyi: 3 other uploads in same shard retried successfully; only this stream consistently failed across retries.

dave: can we manual-promote by referencing the partial upload checksum? or do we need a full valid artifact?

release-manager: decision needed: pin to last good release (v2.16.3) or wait for a rerun now and try to re-upload? change window ends in 33 minutes. thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

erin: if we pin we'll block the new features. but waiting risks missing the window. i'd prefer a quick rerun with a different runner and a single-threaded upload. low-risk.

bob: +1 rerun but with a different registry path and then reconcile. maybe upload to s3-us-east-2 fallback bucket: `s3://redwood-fallback/releases` and then atomically copy to main if verified.

alice: how long to trigger rerun? i can kick it now but will take ~10-12m to finish upload if network stable.

carla: also check cache eviction on the upload runner. last night the runner had a big /tmp purge and we saw truncated streams. can we pin runner image to v1.9 (known-good) for the retry?

dave: command to re-run with pinned runner: `ci retry 12345 --runner-image=runner:v1.9 --upload-bucket=s3://redwood-fallback/releases`

release-manager: sounds reasonable. if rerun fails twice, we pin to v2.16.3 and schedule out-of-band release tomorrow morning. are we aligned?

bob: i'm on it, kicking rerun now and switching runner image. will also set `UPLOAD_RETRIES=10` and `SINGLE_STREAM_UPLOAD=true` envs.

deploybot: rerun started: job 12345-retry-1. will post status.

alice: thanks. tagging infra: @dave and @erin please watch network egress for the runner pool.

ci-bot: job 12345-retry-1: upload in progress... 30%

carla: if upload finishes, we should verify checksum before promoting: `sha256sum v2.17.0.tar.gz` vs build metadata. also update release notes draft to include rollback plan.

bob: update: upload completed to fallback bucket. checksum matches. copying to primary bucket now (`aws s3 cp s3://redwood-fallback/releases/v2.17.0.tar.gz s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/`)

deploybot: copy succeeded, artifact verified. Promotion ready. Action required: release-manager manual confirm to proceed with promote within change window.

release-manager: Approved. Proceed with promote. updating release notes and stamping the release. :shipit:

alice: nice recovery. quick follow-up: open a ticket to improve upload retry/backoff and consider multipart uploads with checkpointing to avoid full reuploads on stream faults.

erin: noted, i'll create infra ticket with logs and suggested mitigations.

bob: marking the original upload failure as transient and linking the fallback flow in runbook.

ci-bot: job 12345-retry-1 finished SUCCESS. promotion complete.

deploybot: Promotion complete for v2.17.0 at 7123456805. release notes: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/v2.17.0

release-manager: thanks everyone. postmortem optional for minor transient infra blip, but let's track the ticket. :eyes:
